502: static inline uint32_t uart_ll_wait_tx_over(void)
503: {
504: 	uint32_t uart_wait_us;
505: 	uint32_t baudrate0;
506: 	uint32_t baudrate1;
507: 	uint32_t baudrate2;
508: 
509: 	uart_hw_t *hw0 = (uart_hw_t *)UART_LL_REG_BASE(0);
510: 	uart_hw_t *hw1 = (uart_hw_t *)UART_LL_REG_BASE(1);
511: 	uart_hw_t *hw2 = (uart_hw_t *)UART_LL_REG_BASE(2);
512: 
513: 	baudrate0 = UART_CLOCK / (hw0->config.clk_div + 1);
514: 	baudrate1 = UART_CLOCK / (hw1->config.clk_div + 1);
515: 	baudrate2 = UART_CLOCK / (hw2->config.clk_div + 1);
516: 
517: 	uart_wait_us = 1000000 * hw2->fifo_status.tx_fifo_count * 10 / baudrate2
518: 				 + 1000000 * hw1->fifo_status.tx_fifo_count * 10 / baudrate1
519: 				 + 1000000 * hw0->fifo_status.tx_fifo_count * 10 / baudrate0;
520: 
521: 	while (!hw2->fifo_status.tx_fifo_empty);
522: 	while (!hw1->fifo_status.tx_fifo_empty);
523: 	while (!hw0->fifo_status.tx_fifo_empty);
524: 
525: 	return uart_wait_us;
526: }

15: #include "os/os.h"

19: 
20: #define MPU_MAX_NUM_REGIONS     (16UL)  
21: #define MPU_MAX_NUM_ATTRS       (8UL)   
22: 
23: static ARM_MPU_Region_t *s_mpu_regions;
24: static uint32_t s_mpu_regions_cnt = 0;
25: static uint8_t *s_mpu_attrs;
26: static uint32_t s_mpu_attrs_cnt = 0;
27: 
28: extern void mpu_soc_cfg(void);
29: 
30: void mpu_register_regions(ARM_MPU_Region_t *regions, uint32_t region_cnt)
31: {
32: 	BK_ASSERT(regions);
33: 	BK_ASSERT(region_cnt);
34: 
35: 	s_mpu_regions = regions;
36: 	s_mpu_regions_cnt = region_cnt;
37: }
38: 
39: void mpu_register_attrs(uint8_t *attrs, uint32_t cnt)
40: {
41: 	BK_ASSERT(attrs);
42: 	BK_ASSERT(cnt);
43: 
44: 	s_mpu_attrs = attrs;
45: 	s_mpu_attrs_cnt = cnt;
46: }
47: 
48: void mpu_clear(uint32_t rnr)
49: {
50:     ARM_MPU_Disable();
51:     ARM_MPU_ClrRegion(rnr);
52: #if CONFIG_SPE
53:     ARM_MPU_Enable(MPU_CTRL_HFNMIENA_Msk);
54: #else
55:     ARM_MPU_Enable(MPU_CTRL_PRIVDEFENA_Msk | MPU_CTRL_HFNMIENA_Msk);
56: #endif
57: }
58: 
59: void mpu_cfg(uint32_t rnr, uint32_t rbar, uint32_t rlar)
60: {
61:     ARM_MPU_Disable();
62:     ARM_MPU_SetRegion(rnr, rbar, rlar);
63: #if CONFIG_SPE
64:     ARM_MPU_Enable(MPU_CTRL_HFNMIENA_Msk);
65: #else
66:     ARM_MPU_Enable(MPU_CTRL_PRIVDEFENA_Msk | MPU_CTRL_HFNMIENA_Msk);
67: #endif
68:     SCB_CleanInvalidateDCache();
69: }
70: 
71: void mpu_enable(void)
72: {
73:     uint32_t region_num;
74:     uint32_t attr_num;
75: 
76: 	mpu_soc_cfg();
77: 	region_num = s_mpu_regions_cnt;
78: 	attr_num = s_mpu_attrs_cnt;
79: 	
80:     ARM_MPU_Disable();
81: 
82:     if (region_num > MPU_MAX_NUM_REGIONS){
83:         region_num = MPU_MAX_NUM_REGIONS;
84:     }
85: 
86:     for (int i = 0; i < region_num; i++) {
87:         ARM_MPU_SetRegion(i, s_mpu_regions[i].RBAR, s_mpu_regions[i].RLAR);
88:     }
89: 
90:     for (int j = 0; j < attr_num; j++) {
91:         ARM_MPU_SetMemAttr(j, s_mpu_attrs[j]);
92:     }
93: 
94: #if CONFIG_SPE
95:     ARM_MPU_Enable(MPU_CTRL_HFNMIENA_Msk);
96: #else
97:     ARM_MPU_Enable(MPU_CTRL_PRIVDEFENA_Msk | MPU_CTRL_HFNMIENA_Msk);
98: #endif
99: }
100: 
101: void mpu_disable(void)
102: {
103:     ARM_MPU_Disable();
104:     for (uint32_t i = 0; i < MPU_MAX_NUM_REGIONS; i++) {
105:       ARM_MPU_ClrRegion(i);
106:     }
107: }
108:

171: {
172: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
173:

175: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);
176: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
177:

181: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
182: {
183: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
184: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
185: 	u16 			chnl_type;
186: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
187: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
188: 
189: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
190: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
191: 
192: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
193: 		return 4;
194: 
195: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
196: 		return 5;
197: 
198: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
199: 		return 3;
200: 
201: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
202: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
203: 
204: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
205: 		return 1;
206: 
207: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
208: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
209: 
210: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
211: 
212: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
213: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
214: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
215: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
216: 
217: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
218: 
219: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
220: 
221: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
222: 
223: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
224: 
225: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
226: 	{
227: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
228: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
229: 
230: 		return 2;
231: 	}
232: 
233: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
234: 
235: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
236: 
237: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
238: 	{
239: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	return 0;
243: }

245: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
246: {
247: 	u8		log_chnl;
248: 	u8		ret_code;
249: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
250: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
251: 
252: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
253: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
254: 
255: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
256: 
257: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
258: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
259: 
260: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
261: 
262: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
263: 		return;
264: 
265: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
266: 		return;
267: 
268: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
269: 		return;
270: 
271: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
272: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
273: 
274: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
275: 		return;
276: 
277: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
278: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
279: 	{
280: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
281: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
282: 
283: 		return;
284: 	}
285: 
286: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
287: 	{
288: 		/* clear following header members. */
289: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
290: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
291: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
292: 
293: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
294: 
295: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
296: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
297: 	}
298: 
299: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
300: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
301: 	{
302: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
303: 			break;
304: 	}
305: 
306: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
307: 	{
308: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
309: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
310: 		return;
311: 	}
312: 
313: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
314: 
315: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
316: 
317: 	if(ret_code != 0)
318: 	{
319: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
320: 	}
321: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
322: 
323: 	return;
324: 
325: }

327: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
328: {
329: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
330: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
331: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
332: 	u16 		chnl_type;

334: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;

338: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;

340: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
341: 
342: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
343: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);

345: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
346: 		return;

352: 		return;
353: 
354: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
355: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
356: 
357: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
358: 
359: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
360: 	{
361: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
362: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
363: 
364: 		return;
365: 	}
366: 
367: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
368: 	{
369: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
370: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
371: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
372: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
373: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
374: 
375: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
376: 
377: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
378: 	}
379: 	else
380: 	{
381: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
382: 	}
383: 
384: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
385: 	{
386: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
387: 		return;
388: 	}
389: 
390: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
391: 
392: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
393: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
394: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
395: 
396: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
397: 
398: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
399: 
400: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
401: 
402: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
403: 	{
404: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
405: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
406: 
407: 		return;
408: 	}
409: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
410: 	return;
411: }

413: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
414: {
415: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
416: 
417: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
418: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
419: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
420: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
421: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
422: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
423: 
424: 	/*
425: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
426: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
427: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
428: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
429: 	 */
430: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
431: 	{
432: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
433: 	}
434: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
435: 	{
436: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
437: 	}
438: }

440: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
441: {
442: 	u8		ret_code;
443: 
444: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
445: 
446: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
447: 
448: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
449: 
450: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
451: 		return;
452: 
453: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
454: 		return;
455: 
456: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
457: 
458: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
459: 	{
460: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
461: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
462: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
463: 
464: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
465: 
466: 		if(ret_code != 0)
467: 		{
468: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
469: 		}
470: 	}
471: 
472: 	return;
473: }

475: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;

477: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
478: {
479: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
480: 	u16 			chnl_type;
481: 
482: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
483: 
484: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
485: 
486: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
487: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
488: 
489: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
490: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
491: 
492: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
493: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
494: 
495: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
496: 
497: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
498: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
499: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
500: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
501: 
502: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
503: 
504: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
505: 
506: 	/*
507: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
508: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
509: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
510: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
511: 	 */
512: 	while(1)
513: 	{
514: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
515: 
516: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
517: 		{
518: 			break;
519: 		}
520: 	}
521: 
522: 	return ret_code;
523: }

525: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_reset(u8 dst_cpu)
526: {
527: 	u16 				chnl_type;
528: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	cmd_buf = {0};
529: 
530: 	if(SELF_CPU == dst_cpu)
531: 	{
532: 		return BK_OK;

542: 
543: 	return BK_OK;
544: }

576: 		{

578: 		}
579: 	}

581: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
582: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
583: 	{
584: 		return ret_code;
585: 	}

587: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;

710:   * write to logical chnanel.
711:   * input:
712:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
713:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
714:   * return:
715:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
716:   *     failed  : fail code.
717:   *
718:   */
719: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
720: {
721: 	u16		write_len;
722: 
723: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
724: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
725: 
726: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
727: 
728: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
729: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
730: 
731: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
732: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
733: 
734: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
735: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
736: 
737: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
738: 
739: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
740: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
741: 
742: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
743: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
744: 
745: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
746: 
747: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
748: 	{
749: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
750: 		
751: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
752: 	}
753: 
754: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
755: 
756: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
757: 
758: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
759: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
760: 
761: 	mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
762: 
763: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
764: 
765: 	return BK_OK;
766: }

768: /*
769:   * logical chnanel misc io (set/get param).
770:   * input:
771:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to set/get param.
772:   *     cmd          : control command for logical channel.
773:   *     param      :  parameter of the command.
774:   * return:
775:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
776:   *     failed  : fail code.
777:   *
778:   */
779: bk_err_t mb_chnl_ctrl(u8 log_chnl, u8 cmd, void * param)
780: {
781: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
782: 
783: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
784: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
785: 
786: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
787: 
788: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
789: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
790: 
791: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
792: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
793: 
794: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
795: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
796: 
797: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
798: 
799: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
800: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
801: 
802: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
803: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
804: 
805: 	switch(cmd)
806: 	{
807: 		case MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS:
808: 
809: 			if(param == NULL)
810: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
811: 
812: 			*((u8 *)param) = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state;
813: 			
814: 			break;
815: 
816: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR:
817: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = (chnl_rx_isr_t)param;
818: 			break;
819: 
820: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR:
821: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = (chnl_tx_isr_t)param;
822: 			break;
823: 
824: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:
825: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = (chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)param;
826: 			break;
827: 
828: 		case MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC:
829: 			if(param == NULL)
830: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
831: 
832: 			ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(log_chnl, (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)param);
833: 			return ret_code;
834: 			break;
835: 
836: 		default:
837: 			return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
838: 			break;
839: 	}
840: 
841: 	return BK_OK;
842: }

74: {
75: 	(void)arg;
76: 
77: 	mbox0_message_t message;
78: 
79: 	if(dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
80: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
81: 
82: 	if(data == NULL)
83: 	{
84: 		return BK_FAIL;
85: 	}
86: 
87: 	/*
88: 	int box = TX_CMD_BOX;
89: 
90: 	if(arg != NULL)
91: 	{
92: 		box = (*(uint16_t *)arg) & 0xFF;
93: 	}
94: 
95: 	if(box >= TX_BOX_NUM)
96: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_ID;
97: 	*/
98: 	
99: 	uint32_t fifo_status = 0;
100: 
101: 	int ret_code = mbox0_drv_get_send_stat((uint32_t)dst, &fifo_status);
102: 
103: 	if(ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)

105: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
106: 	}
107: 
108: 	if(RX_FIFO_STAT_FULL & fifo_status)

111: 	}

113: 	mailbox_tx_box[dst] = (mailbox_tx_box[dst] + 1) % TX_BOX_NUM;

115: 	int box = mailbox_tx_box[dst];
116: 
117: 	memcpy(&mailbox_buff[dst][box], data, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
118: 	
119: 	message.data[0] = (u32)(&mailbox_buff[dst][box]);
120: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
121: 	message.dest_cpu = (uint8_t)dst;
122: 
123: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_send_message(&message);
124: 
125: 	if(ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
126: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_NOT_INIT;
127: 
128: 	return BK_OK;
129: }

1: #include "sdkconfig.h"
2: #include "cpu_id.h"
3: #include "mbox0_drv.h"
4: #include "sys_driver.h"
5: 
6: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
7: // cpu0 + smp(cpu1,cpu2)
8: #define MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_LEN     2
9: #define MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_LEN     3
10: #define MBOX0_CHN2_FIFO_LEN     3
11: #else //#if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
12: #define MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_LEN     2
13: #define MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_LEN     4
14: #define MBOX0_CHN2_FIFO_LEN     2
15: #endif //#if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
16: 
17: #define MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_START     0
18: #define MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_START     (MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_START + MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_LEN)
19: #define MBOX0_CHN2_FIFO_START     (MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_START + MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_LEN)
20: 
21: //struct mbox0_fifo_cfg_t:
22: #define MBOX0_FIFO_CFG_TABLE   \
23: {   \
24: 	{MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_START, MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_LEN}, \
25: 	{MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_START, MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_LEN}, \
26: 	{MBOX0_CHN2_FIFO_START, MBOX0_CHN2_FIFO_LEN}, \
27: }
28: 
29: 
30: static mbox0_dev_t       mbox0_dev;
31: static u8                mbox0_init = 0;
32: 
33: static const mbox0_fifo_cfg_t  fifo_cfg[] = MBOX0_FIFO_CFG_TABLE;
34: 	
35: static int mbox0_drv_recieve_message(mbox0_message_t* message)
36: {
37: 	return mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_recv(&mbox0_dev.hal, message);
38: }
39: 
40: static void mbox0_drv_isr_handler(void)
41: {
42: 	uint32_t int_status;
43: 	uint32_t fifo_status;
44: 	mbox0_message_t message;
45: 
46: 	int_status = mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_get_int_status(&mbox0_dev.hal);
47: 
48: 	if(int_status == 0)
49: 		return;
50: 
51: 	do
52: 	{
53: 		fifo_status = mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_get_rx_fifo_stat(&mbox0_dev.hal);
54: 		
55: 		if(fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_NOT_EMPTY)
56: 		{
57: 			mbox0_drv_recieve_message(&message);
58: 
59: 			if(message.data[1] != 0)  /* message data len is not 0. */
60: 			{
61: 				if(mbox0_dev.rx_callback != NULL)
62: 					mbox0_dev.rx_callback(&message);
63: 			}
64: 			else
65: 			{
66: 				#if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
67: 				extern void crosscore_smp_cmd_handler(uint8_t src_core, uint32_t cmd);
68: 				
69: 				crosscore_smp_cmd_handler(message.src_cpu, message.data[0]);
70: 				#endif
71: 			}
72: 		}
73: 		else
74: 		{
75: 			break;
76: 		}
77: 	} while(1);
78: 	
79: }
80: 
81: int mbox0_drv_get_send_stat(uint32_t dest_cpu, uint32_t *fifo_status)
82: {
83: 	if((dest_cpu >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM) || (fifo_status == NULL))
84: 	{
85: 		return MBOX0_HAL_SW_PARAM_ERR;
86: 	}
87: 
88: 	*fifo_status = mbox0_dev.chn_drv[dest_cpu]->chn_get_rx_fifo_stat(&mbox0_dev.hal);
89: 
90: 	return MBOX0_HAL_OK;
91: }
92: 
93: int mbox0_drv_send_message(mbox0_message_t* message)
94: {
95: 	return mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_send(&mbox0_dev.hal, message);
96: }
97: 
98: int mbox0_drv_callback_register(mbox0_rx_callback_t callback)
99: {
100: 	mbox0_dev.rx_callback = callback;
101: 
102: 	return 0;
103: }
104: 
105: int mbox0_init_on_current_core(int id)
106: {
107: 	int int_src = INT_SRC_MAILBOX;
108: 
109: 	if(CPU0_CORE_ID == id)
110: 	{
111: 		mbox0_hal_dev_init(&mbox0_dev.hal);  /* can only be initialized by CPU0. */
112: 		mbox0_hal_set_reg_0x2_chn_pro_disable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 1); /* channel unprotect */
113: 
114: 		for(int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(fifo_cfg); i++)
115: 			mbox0_dev.chn_drv[i]->chn_cfg_fifo(&mbox0_dev.hal, fifo_cfg[i].start, fifo_cfg[i].len);
116: 	}
117: 
118: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[id]->chn_int_enable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 1);
119: 
120: 	/* clear/empty RX FIFO. */
121: 	while(1)
122: 	{
123: 		mbox0_message_t message;
124: 
125: 		uint32_t fifo_status = mbox0_dev.chn_drv[id]->chn_get_rx_fifo_stat(&mbox0_dev.hal);
126: 		
127: 		if(fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_NOT_EMPTY)
128: 		{
129: 			mbox0_drv_recieve_message(&message);
130: 		}
131: 		else
132: 		{
133: 			break;
134: 		}
135: 	}
136: 
137: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
138: 	/* enable system interrupt, every channel is hard-bound to a processor */
139: 	sys_drv_core_intr_group2_enable(id, (1 << (int_src - 32)));
140: #else
141: 	sys_drv_int_group2_enable(1 << (int_src - 32));
142: #endif
143: 
144: 	return 0;
145: }
146: 
147: int mbox0_drv_init(void)
148: {
149: 	if(mbox0_init == 1)
150: 		return 0;
151: 
152: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[0] = &hal_chn0_drv;
153: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[1] = &hal_chn1_drv;
154: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[2] = &hal_chn2_drv;
155: 
156: 	mbox0_dev.rx_callback = NULL;
157: 
158: 	mbox0_hal_init(&mbox0_dev.hal);
159: 
160: 	int int_src = INT_SRC_MAILBOX;
161: 
162: 	bk_int_isr_register(int_src, mbox0_drv_isr_handler, NULL);
163: 
164: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
165: 	mbox0_init_on_current_core(CPU1_CORE_ID);
166: 	mbox0_init_on_current_core(CPU2_CORE_ID);
167: #else
168: 	mbox0_init_on_current_core(SELF_CHNL);
169: #endif
170: 
171: 	mbox0_init = 1;
172: 
173: 	return 0;
174: }
175: 
176: int mbox0_drv_deinit(void)
177: {
178: 	if(mbox0_init == 0)
179: 		return 0;
180: 
181: 	uint8_t int_src = INT_SRC_MAILBOX;
182: 
183: 	// sys_drv_int_group2_disable(1 << (int_src - 32));
184: 
185: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
186: 	/* disable system interrupt, every channel is hard-bound to a processor */
187: 	sys_drv_core_intr_group2_disable(CPU0_CORE_ID, (1 << (int_src - 32)));
188: 	
189: 	/* disable system interrupt, every channel is hard-bound to a processor */
190: 	sys_drv_core_intr_group2_disable(CPU1_CORE_ID, (1 << (int_src - 32)));
191: 
192: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[CPU1_CORE_ID]->chn_int_enable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 0);
193: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[CPU2_CORE_ID]->chn_int_enable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 0);
194: #else
195: 	sys_drv_int_group2_disable(1 << (int_src - 32));
196: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_int_enable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 0);
197: #endif
198: 
199: 	bk_int_isr_unregister(int_src);
200: 
201: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
202: 	mbox0_hal_dev_deinit(&mbox0_dev.hal);  /* can only be de-initialized by CPU0. */
203: #else
204: 	if(SELF_CHNL == 0)
205: 		mbox0_hal_dev_deinit(&mbox0_dev.hal);  /* can only be de-initialized by CPU0. */
206: #endif
207: 
208: 	mbox0_hal_deinit(&mbox0_dev.hal);
209: 	
210: 	mbox0_dev.rx_callback = NULL;
211: 
212: 	mbox0_init = 0;
213: 
214: 	return 0;
215: }

51: /* ======================================================================================= */

53: #define SELF_CPU		MAILBOX_CPU1

55: enum
56: {
57: 	/* CPU1 --> CPU1 */
58: 	CP1_MB_LOG_CHNL_START   = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, MAILBOX_CPU1),
59: 
60: 	CP1_MB_LOG_CHNL_END,
61: 	CP1_MB_LOG_CHNL_MAX = (CP1_MB_LOG_CHNL_START + LOG_CHNL_ID_MASK), // max 16 channels.
62: };
63: 
64: /* the BIGGER the value, the LOWER the channel priority. */
65: enum
66: {
67: 	/* CPU1 --> CPU2 */
68: 	CP2_MB_LOG_CHNL_START   = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, MAILBOX_CPU2),

80: 	CP0_MB_CHNL_IPC,

121: {
122: 	mb_chnl_hdr_t	hdr;

126: 	u32		param3;
127: } mb_chnl_cmd_t;

129: enum
130: {
131: 	ACK_STATE_PENDING = 0x01,		/* cmd is being handled in the peer CPU. */
132: 	ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 			/* cmd handling is competed, addtional infos in ack_data1&ack_data2. */
133: 	ACK_STATE_FAIL, 				/* cmd failed, addtional infos in ack_data1&ack_data2. */
134: };
135: 
136: typedef struct
137: {
138: 	mb_chnl_hdr_t	hdr;
139: 
140: 	u32		ack_data1;
141: 	u32		ack_data2;
142: 	union
143: 	{
144: 		u32		ack_data3;
145: 		u32		ack_state;				/* ack_state or ack_data3, depends on applications. */
146: 	};
147: } mb_chnl_ack_t;

149: typedef void  (* chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)(void *param, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf);
150: typedef void  (* chnl_tx_isr_t)(void *param);

152: /*
153:  *  rx_isr firstly use the buf as the command buffer, after handled the cmd,
154:  *  then use the buf as acknowledge buffer to fill the handle result.
155:  */
156: typedef void  (* chnl_rx_isr_t)(void *param, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf);
157: 
158: enum
159: {
160: 	MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS = 0,
161: 	MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR,
162: 	MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR,
163: 	MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR,
164: 	MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC,
165: 	MB_CHNL_TX_RESET,
166: };

168: 
169: 
170: /*
171:   * init logical chnanel module.
172:   * return:
173:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
174:   *     failed  : fail code.
175:   *
176:   */
177: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void);
178: 
179: /*
180:   * open logical chnanel.
181:   * input:
182:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to open.
183:   *     callback_param : param passsed to all callbacks.
184:   * return:
185:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
186:   *     failed  : fail code.
187:   *
188:   */
189: bk_err_t mb_chnl_open(u8 log_chnl, void * callback_param);
190: 
191: /*
192:   * close logical chnanel.
193:   * input:
194:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to close.
195:   * return:
196:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
197:   *     failed  : fail code.
198:   *
199:   */
200: bk_err_t mb_chnl_close(u8 log_chnl);
201: 
202: /*
203:   * read from logical chnanel.
204:   * input:
205:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to read.
206:   *     read_buf       : buffer to receive channel cmd data.
207:   * return:
208:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
209:   *     failed  : fail code.
210:   *
211:   */
212: bk_err_t mb_chnl_read(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * read_buf);
213: 
214: /*
215:   * write to logical chnanel.
216:   * input:
217:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
218:   *     cmd_buf       : command buffer to send.
219:   *
220:   * return:
221:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
222:   *     failed  : fail code.
223:   *
224:   */
225: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf);
226: 
227: /*
228:   * logical chnanel misc io (set/get param).
229:   * input:
230:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to set/get param.
231:   *     cmd          : control command for logical channel.
232:   *     param      :  parameter of the command.
233:   *        MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS:   param, (u8 *) point to buffer (one byte in size.) to receive status data.
234:   *        MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR:   param, pointer to rx_isr_callback.
235:   *        MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR:   param, pointer to tx_isr_callback.
236:   *        MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:   param, pointer to tx_cmpl_isr_callback.
237:   *        MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC:   param, pointer to mb_chnl_cmd_t buffer, write to mailbox synchronously.
238:   *        MB_CHNL_TX_RESET: param is NULL.
239:   * return:
240:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
241:   *     failed  : fail code.
242:   *
243:   */
244: bk_err_t mb_chnl_ctrl(u8 log_chnl, u8 cmd, void * param);
245: 
246:

248: }

290: 	if (gpio_cfg == NULL)

300: {
301: 	uint32_t  i = 0;
302: 	uint32_t val = 0;
303: 
304: 	if (gpio_cfg == NULL)
305: 		return;
306: 
307: 	for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
308: 		val = REG_READ(GPIO_LL_REG_BASE+i*4);
309: 		val &= 0xffff0000;
310: 		val |= gpio_cfg[i];
311: 		REG_WRITE((GPIO_LL_REG_BASE+i*4), val);
312: 	}
313: }

以下结论仅来自 `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp` 中可见源码，未修改任何文件。BK7258 AP 配置是 Cortex-M33 SMP，默认 `CONFIG_SPE=1`，因此下文首先给出源码实际使用的 Secure 地址；若 NuttX 运行在 Non-secure 世界，外设/存储地址通常要加 `0x10000000`，但必须由实际启动链和 SAU/MPC 配置确认。

## 1. 总体结论

BK7258 AP vendor port 的最小实现可以拆为：

1. **启动入口**
   - 设置 MSP limit、VTOR、FPU/TCM、故障使能；
   - 装载 ITCM/DTCM；
   - 配置 MPU；
   - 最后进入 NuttX。
2. **UART1**
   - 打开 UART1 时钟/电源；
   - 选择 26 MHz XTAL；
   - GPIO0/1 pinmux 到 UART1 TX/RX；
   - UART1 soft reset；
   - 配置 8N1、分频、FIFO；
   - 清中断、启动 TX/RX；
   - 如使用中断，再打开 SoC 路由和 NVIC IRQ 15。
3. **mailbox v2.0**
   - 使用的是 `MBOX0` FIFO 硬件，不是旧式双 box 四参数硬件；
   - 硬件每条 FIFO 消息只有两个 32 位数据，其中实际传递的是：
     `共享内存中的 mailbox_data_t 指针 + 长度16`；
   - 上层再在 16 字节中封装 logical-channel header、命令/ACK。
4. **MPU**
   - ARMv8-M RBAR/RLAR/MAIR 模型；
   - 先 disable，依次写 region，然后写 MAIR，最后 enable；
   - `CONFIG_SPE=1` 时源码以 `CTRL=ENABLE|HFNMIENA` 启用，不设置 `PRIVDEFENA`。

可直接复用的最有价值部分是纯寄存器 HAL/结构定义；RTOS、PM、IRQ 注册、spinlock、cache API 和启动胶水必须按 NuttX 重写。

---

# 2. 地址空间与 AP 身份

## 2.1 Secure/Non-secure 地址差

路径：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/soc/bk7258/reg_base.h:19-29`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:42-53`

事实：

```c
SOC_S_NS_ADDR_DIFF = 0x10000000;

CONFIG_SPE=1:
    SOC_ADDR_OFFSET = 0;
else:
    SOC_ADDR_OFFSET = 0x10000000;
```

因此源码默认地址：

| 模块 | Secure 地址 | 推导出的 NS alias |
|---|---:|---:|
| SYS | `0x44010000` | `0x54010000` |
| AON GPIO | `0x44000400` | `0x54000400` |
| UART1 | `0x45830000` | `0x55830000` |
| MBOX0 v2 | `0x41000000` | `0x51000000` |
| SRAM shared | `0x28000000...` | `0x38000000...` |

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/soc/bk7258/reg_base.h:51-80`

## 2.2 AP mailbox CPU ID

mailbox logical-channel 层固定：

```c
#define SELF_CPU MAILBOX_CPU1
```

来源：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:47-79`

因此这里的 AP 软件逻辑端点是 `MAILBOX_CPU1 == 1`，主要与 `MAILBOX_CPU0 == 0` 通信。

注意：AP 工程内部又启用了 SMP，`CONFIG_CPU_CNT=2` 且 `CONFIG_SOC_SMP=y`，`SYSTEM_CPU_NUM` 会是 `CONFIG_CPU_CNT + 1 == 3`。见：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:14-15`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:26-30`

## 3.1 CPU0 reset 路径

```c
{
    irq_disable_all();

    set_msp_limit(__stack_limit);
    SCB->VTOR = (uintptr_t)g_vector_table;

    enable_fpu_cp10_cp11();
```

```c
/* GPIO function selector: GPIO0/GPIO1 both mode 0 */

/* Preserve unrelated/read-only bits. */
```

## 4.5 UART1 最小初始化顺序

vendor 驱动的关键顺序：

```text
enable system UART interrupt route
uart_id_init_common:
    power/clock enable
    initially select XTAL
    pinmux GPIO
select requested source clock
configure UART registers
enable TX/RX
```

来源：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/uart/uart_driver.c:1047-1149`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/uart/uart_driver.c:400-425`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/common/hal/uart_hal.c:31-60`

对 NuttX 更安全的最小顺序建议：

```c
#define SYS_BASE       0x44010000u
#define UART1_BASE     0x45830000u
#define GPIO_BASE      0x44000400u

void bk7258_uart1_init(uint32_t baud)
{
    /* 1. Clock/power */
    modify32(SYS_BASE + 0x30, 0, BIT(10));       /* UART1_CKEN */
    modify32(SYS_BASE + 0x20, BIT(13), 0);       /* CKSEL=XTAL */
    /* divider bits 11:12 normally remain /1 */

    /* 2. Pinmux GPIO0/1 */
    configure_gpio0_gpio1_uart1();

    /* 3. Soft reset/release according to vendor convention */
    putreg32(BIT(0), UART1_BASE + 0x08);

    /* 4. Disable UART-local interrupts and clear W1C status */
    putreg32(0,    UART1_BASE + 0x20);
    putreg32(0xff, UART1_BASE + 0x24);

    /* 5. 8N1 and XTAL divider */
    uint32_t div = 26000000u / baud - 1u;
    uint32_t cfg =
        BIT(0) | BIT(1) |           /* TX/RX enable */
        (3u << 3) |                 /* 8 bits */
        (div << 8);                 /* parity off, 1 stop */
    putreg32(cfg, UART1_BASE + 0x10);

    /* 6. Vendor FIFO defaults */
    putreg32(0x20u | (0x40u << 8) | (0u << 16),
             UART1_BASE + 0x14);

    putreg32(0, UART1_BASE + 0x28); /* no flow control */
    putreg32(0, UART1_BASE + 0x2c); /* no wake */

    /* 7. Optional RX interrupt */
    putreg32(BIT(1) | BIT(6), UART1_BASE + 0x20);

    /* Select the correct per-core route register */
    modify32(SYS_UART_ROUTE_REG, 0, BIT(15));
    up_enable_irq(15);
}
```

常量来源：

- XTAL UART clock：`CONFIG_XTAL_FREQ`，通常 26 MHz：
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/hal/hal_uart_types.h:44-51`
- 8N1 枚举值：
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/hal/hal_uart_types.h:73-100`
- 分频公式：
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/common/hal/uart_hal.c:83-102`

### UART 无法完全确认的部分

1. `sys_drv_dev_clk_pwr_up()` 最终调用 PM 框架，不仅仅是设置 `UART1_CKEN`：
   - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_clock_driver.c:19-25`
   
   SYS `0x0e` 还包含 `uart1_sd` shutdown 位：
   - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sys_struct.h:262-299`
   
   因此“只置 CKEN 是否足以从所有低功耗复位状态唤醒 UART1”不能仅靠此源码确认。
2. `soft_reset` 名字与写 `1` 的行为暗示它可能实际是 reset release/soft reset pulse，但缺少完整寄存器手册，不能确认是否需要 `0 -> 1` 脉冲。
3. 分频公式使用整数截断，未做最接近值舍入；实际误差容限需硬件测试。
4. UART1 IRQ 应路由到 CPU0 还是 CPU1，取决于 NuttX 实际运行 core，不应机械使用 CPU0 的 `0x44010080`。

## 5.3 每 channel 寄存器公式

三个 channel block：


对 channel `n`：

```text
CBASE(n) = MBOX0_BASE + 0x40 + n*0x40

CBASE+0x00 CONFIG/STATUS
  bits0:5   fifo_start
  bit8      int_en
  bit9      int_wrerr_en
  bit10     int_rderr_en
  bit11     int_wrfull_en

  bit17     rderr status, W1C
  bit18     wrfull status, W1C
  bit19     fifo_not_empty, R

CBASE+0x04 CHANNEL
  bit0      channel enable
  bits1:6   FIFO length

CBASE+0x08 TX_DATA0
CBASE+0x0c TX_DATA1
CBASE+0x10 TID[3:0]       /* 写 TID 同时开始发送 */
CBASE+0x14 SID[3:0]       /* 读 SID 同时开始接收/弹出 */
CBASE+0x18 RX_DATA0
CBASE+0x1c RX_DATA1
CBASE+0x20 FIFO_STATUS
  bit0      full
  bit1      empty
  bits2:7   count
```

```c

    uint32_t param0;
    uint32_t param1;
    uint32_t param2;
    uint32_t param3;
```

- 双方使用兼容 alias；
- 发送前 clean D-cache；
- 接收前 invalidate D-cache；

vendor 接收端调用名为 `flush_dcache()` 的函数，但仅靠名字无法确认它究竟执行 clean、invalidate 还是二者：

## 5.8 Mailbox v2 最小初始化伪代码

```c
#define MBOX0 0x41000000u

static uintptr_t chbase(unsigned ch)
{
    return MBOX0 + 0x40u + ch * 0x40u;
}

void mbox_v2_hw_init_cpu0(void)
{
    /* Optional sanity checks */
    assert(getreg32(MBOX0 + 0x00) == 0x6d61696c);
    assert(getreg32(MBOX0 + 0x04) == 0x00020000);

    /* Release/reset convention follows vendor. */
    modify32(MBOX0 + 0x08, BIT(0)|BIT(1)|BIT(2),
             BIT(0) | BIT(2)); /* softrstn=1, no hclk bypass, unprotect */

    /* SMP FIFO 2/3/3 */
    cfg_channel(0, 0, 2);
    cfg_channel(1, 2, 3);
    cfg_channel(2, 5, 3);
}

void cfg_channel(unsigned ch, unsigned start, unsigned len)
{
    uintptr_t b = chbase(ch);

    /* Must set FIFO start before channel enable. */
    modify32(b + 0x00, 0x3f, start);
    modify32(b + 0x04, 0x7f, (len << 1) | BIT(0));

    /* Normal receive interrupt only; vendor disables error IRQ enables. */
    modify32(b + 0x00, BIT(9)|BIT(10)|BIT(11), BIT(8));
}

int mbox_send(unsigned self_ch, unsigned dst,
              uint32_t data0, uint32_t data1)
{
    uintptr_t b = chbase(self_ch);

    if (getreg32(chbase(dst) + 0x20) & BIT(0))
        return -EBUSY;

    putreg32(data0, b + 0x08);
    putreg32(data1, b + 0x0c);
    putreg32(dst & 0xf, b + 0x10); /* LAST: trigger */
    return 0;
}

bool mbox_recv(unsigned self_ch, struct hwmsg *m)
{
    uintptr_t b = chbase(self_ch);

    if (!(getreg32(b + 0x00) & BIT(19)))
        return false;

    m->src   = getreg32(b + 0x14) & 0xf; /* FIRST */
    m->data0 = getreg32(b + 0x18);
    m->data1 = getreg32(b + 0x1c);
    return true;
}
```

然后 adapter 层：

```c
/* sender */
shared->payload = mailbox_data;
dcache_clean(shared, 16);
mbox_send(self, dst, shared_address_visible_to_peer, 16);

/* receiver ISR */
while (mbox_recv(self, &m)) {
    if (m.data1 != 16)
        continue;

    dcache_invalidate((void *)peer_to_local_addr(m.data0), 16);
    memcpy(&local, peer_to_local_addr(m.data0), 16);
    dispatch_logical_channel(&local);
}
```

# 6. MPU

## 6.1 MPU 寄存器地址和位域

该芯片 CMSIS 使用 `core_star.h`，MPU 基址：

```text
SCS_BASE + 0x0d90 = 0xe000ed90
```

结构：

```text
0xe000ed90 TYPE
0xe000ed94 CTRL
0xe000ed98 RNR
0xe000ed9c RBAR
0xe000eda0 RLAR
...
0xe000edc0 MAIR0
0xe000edc4 MAIR1
```

来源：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/CMSIS/Core/Include/core_star.h:1721-1742`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/CMSIS/Core/Include/core_star.h:2345-2368`

位域：

```text
CTRL:
  bit0 ENABLE
  bit1 HFNMIENA
  bit2 PRIVDEFENA

RNR:
  bits0:7 region number

RBAR:
  bits31:5 BASE
  bits4:3 SH
  bits2:1 AP
  bit0 XN

RLAR:
  bits31:5 LIMIT
  bits3:1 AttrIndx
  bit0 ENABLE
```

来源：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/CMSIS/Core/Include/core_star.h:1756-1791`

编码：

```c
AP = (RO << 1) | NP;
RBAR = (base & ~0x1f)
     | (SH << 3)
     | (AP << 1)
     | XN;

RLAR = (limit & ~0x1f)
     | (attr_index << 1)
     | 1;
```

来源：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/CMSIS/Core/Include/mpu_armv8.h:76-102`

## 6.2 MAIR 常量

BK7258 配置：

| Attr index | byte | 含义 |
|---:|---:|---|
| 0 | `0xbb` | Normal, cacheable write-through, RA/WA |
| 1 | `0x44` | Normal non-cacheable |
| 2 | `0x00` | Device nGnRnE |
| 3 | `0xff` | Normal write-back, RA/WA |
| 4 | `0xaa` | Normal write-through, read allocate, no write allocate |

来源：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/mpu_cfg.c:139-149`

即：

```text
MAIR0 = 0xff0044bb
MAIR1 low byte = 0xaa
```

CMSIS 每个 attr 是 MAIR 中一个 8-bit slot：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/CMSIS/Core/Include/mpu_armv8.h:183-208`

## 6.3 默认区域

无额外 LVGL/code-load 条件时，核心区域事实如下：

| Region | Base..Limit | RBAR 属性 | Attr |
|---:|---|---|---:|
| 0 | `0x00000020..0x00003fff` | SH non, RO, NP, executable | 1 |
| 1 | `0x02000000..0x02ffffff` | SH non, RO, NP, executable | 4 |
| 2 | `0x08000000..0x0809ffff` | SH non, RO, NP, executable | 1 |
| 3 | `0x20000000..0x20003fff` | SH non, RW, NP, XN | 1 |
| 4 | 条件相关，通常 `0x28000000..0x3fffffff` | shared SRAM，属性依 cache 配置 | 0 或 1 |
| 5 | `0x40000000..0x5fffffff` | SH inner, RW, NP, XN | 2 |
| 6 | `0x60000000..0x63ffffff` | SH non, RW, NP, XN | 1 |
| 7 | `0x64000000..0x67ffffff` | SH non, RW, NP, XN | 1 |
| 8 | `0x68000000..0x6bffffff` | SH non, RW, NP, XN | 3 |
| 9 | `0x6c000000..0xefffffff` | SH non, RW, NP, XN | 2 |

完整条件定义：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/mpu_cfg.c:38-137`

注意源码的 RLAR 参数写的是末 32-byte 块地址，例如 `0x02ffffe0`；硬件会把低 5 位视为全 1，因此有效 limit 到 `0x02ffffff`。

## 6.4 初始化顺序

vendor：

```text
mpu_soc_cfg()
ARM_MPU_Disable()
for regions:
    RNR = i
    RBAR = region[i].RBAR
    RLAR = region[i].RLAR
for attrs:
    write MAIR slot
if CONFIG_SPE:
    ARM_MPU_Enable(HFNMIENA)
else:
    ARM_MPU_Enable(PRIVDEFENA | HFNMIENA)
```

来源：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/arch/cm33/mpu.c:71-99`

CMSIS enable/disable 含 `DMB/DSB/ISB` 和 MemManage fault enable/disable：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/CMSIS/Core/Include/mpu_armv8.h:127-152`

NuttX 最小伪代码：

```c
void bk7258_mpu_init(void)
{
    dmb();
    MPU_CTRL &= ~BIT(0);
    dsb();
    isb();

    putreg32(0xff0044bb, MPU_MAIR0);
    putreg32(0x000000aa, MPU_MAIR1);

    for (unsigned i = 0; i < nregions; i++) {
        putreg32(i,              MPU_RNR);
        putreg32(regions[i].rbar, MPU_RBAR);
        putreg32(regions[i].rlar, MPU_RLAR);
    }

    /* CONFIG_SPE vendor behavior: ENABLE | HFNMIENA = 0x3 */
    dmb();
    putreg32(BIT(0) | BIT(1), MPU_CTRL);
    SCB->SHCSR |= SCB_SHCSR_MEMFAULTENA_Msk;
    dsb();
    isb();
}
```

## 6.5 MPU 移植注意

1. NuttX 如果运行 Non-secure，应操作 Non-secure MPU 实例；CMSIS 定义的 alias 是：
   ```text
   MPU_NS = 0xe002ed90
   ```
   来源：
   - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/CMSIS/Core/Include/core_star.h:2378-2397`
2. vendor 区域地址表使用 Secure alias；Non-secure NuttX 不能不经审查直接照搬。
3. 区域 4 的范围和 cache 属性强依赖：
   - `CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE`
   - `CONFIG_LVGL_SRAM_MAPPING`
   - `CONFIG_LV_ATTRIBUTE_FAST_MEM_L2`
   - `CONFIG_LVGL_V8`
4. 默认 defconfig 是 `CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE=n`，但启动代码还区分 `CONFIG_ICACHE/CONFIG_DCACHE`；这些宏的最终合成值不能只从这一个 defconfig 行完全确认。
5. vendor 将 `0x40000000..0x5fffffff` 整体设为 Device/XN，这覆盖 SYS、UART、mailbox；NuttX 至少必须保留这个属性，否则 MMIO 可能被错误缓存或重排。

### UART driver

不宜直接搬：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/uart/uart_driver.c`

原因：

- FreeRTOS semaphore/kfifo；

- DMA framework；
- system resource lock；
- log/ASSERT；
- NuttX serial lower-half API 完全不同。

可保留其寄存器初始化顺序和 ISR 清状态逻辑。

### GPIO HAL

`gpio_hal.c` 包含全局 map table、Beken error/log 和设备占用管理，NuttX vendor port 最好只抽取 pinmux RMW 事实：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/common/hal/gpio_hal.c`

### Mailbox driver/channel

必须适配：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c`

原因：

- `bk_int_isr_register`、SYS interrupt route；
- `rtos_disable_int`、spinlock；
- SMP core ID API；
- cache API；
- 静态共享 buffer 生命周期；
- logical-channel callback ABI；
- vendor adapter 的 CPU/channel 编号假设。

如果目标是与现有 CP 固件互通，**协议结构和 channel 常量必须兼容，但调度/锁/缓存/IRQ 层必须重写**。

### 启动

CMSIS startup 不能直接作为 NuttX startup 使用，应抽取：

- VTOR、MSPLIM、FPU、TCM；
- MPU 顺序；
- core release/secondary entry 所需寄存器事实。

NuttX 应接入自身：

- `__start`/`nx_start`
- `.data/.bss` 初始化
- IRQ vector
- SMP secondary boot
- cache/MPU arch API

# 8. 最需要实机或手册确认的清单

1. AP/NuttX 最终是 Secure 还是 Non-secure，以及对应的 UART/GPIO/MBOX/SRAM alias。
2. ROM/bootloader 释放 AP 和各 SMP core 的准确寄存器及先后顺序。
3. UART1 `soft_reset` bit0 是电平式 reset release 还是需要脉冲。
4. UART1 从深睡/掉电恢复时，除 `UART1_CKEN` 外是否必须清 `SYS 0x0e uart1_sd` 或执行其它 PM 序列。
5. mailbox v2 IRQ 路由存在 `IRQ63/group2 bit31` 与 generated `CPU1 MBOX0 bit16` 两套信息，需手册或寄存器探测定案。
6. mailbox `SID` 读取触发 FIFO pop 的精确时点；源码按“先 SID 后 data”实现，移植必须保持这一顺序。
7. `flush_dcache()` 的真实语义，以及对端是否使用相同 shared-memory alias。
8. mailbox pointer payload 在 AP/CP 两端的地址转换规则；源码没有显式进行 Secure/Non-secure alias 转换。
9. MBOX0 全局 FIFO 划分只能由哪个 CPU 配置。源码注释称只能 CPU0 初始化，但 SMP `mbox0_drv_init()` 路径调用 CPU1/CPU2 初始化，存在命名/调用语义歧义：
   - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c:105-169`
10. MPU region 4 在 NuttX 实际 cache 配置下应采用 attr0 还是 attr1，以及 shared mailbox buffer 是否必须单独做 non-cacheable region。

以上未确认项中，前五项会直接影响“能否启动、能否打印、能否收中断”，应优先用 BK7258 TRM、bootloader map 或实机 MMIO dump 验证。
